diagnosis.cause: .env.example leaves 16 required values blank and the app rejects empty values. HUMBLE fills PORT, SERVER_URL, CORS_ORIGIN, ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET and 12 more with local values (the app's own defaults where it has them, generated dev secrets, a local mail catcher for SMTP).

actions.command:
touch .env && { grep -v -E '^(PORT|SERVER_URL|CORS_ORIGIN|ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET|ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE|REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET|REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE|REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE_NAME|MYSQL_DATABASE|MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD|DATABASE_URL|SMTP_HOST|SMTP_PORT|SMTP_USERNAME|SMTP_PASSWORD|EMAIL_FROM)=' .env; printf '%s=%s
' 'PORT' '4000'; printf '%s=%s
' 'SERVER_URL' 'http://localhost:4000'; printf '%s=%s
' 'CORS_ORIGIN' '*'; printf '%s=%s
' 'ACCESS_TOKEN_SECRET' 'change.me.local.dev.only.not.a.secret'; printf '%s=%s
' 'ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE' '20m'; printf '%s=%s
' 'REFRESH_TOKEN_SECRET' 'change.me.local.dev.only.not.a.secret'; printf '%s=%s
' 'REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRE' '1d'; printf '%s=%s
' 'REFRESH_TOKEN_COOKIE_NAME' 'jid'; printf '%s=%s
' 'MYSQL_DATABASE' 'app'; printf '%s=%s
' 'MYSQL_ROOT_PASSWORD' 'change.me.local.dev.only.not.a.secret'; printf '%s=%s
' 'DATABASE_URL' 'mysql://root:change.me.local.dev.only.not.a.secret@localhost:3306/app'; printf '%s=%s
' 'SMTP_HOST' 'localhost'; printf '%s=%s
' 'SMTP_PORT' '1025'; printf '%s=%s
' 'SMTP_USERNAME' 'dev'; printf '%s=%s
' 'SMTP_PASSWORD' 'change.me.local.dev.only.not.a.secret'; printf '%s=%s
' 'EMAIL_FROM' 'dev@example.com'; } > /tmp/firstrun.env && mv /tmp/firstrun.env .env
